title: sideritis cretica var. stricta
intro: Sideritis cretica var. stricta, commonly known as the Greek mountain tea, is a plant species within the genus Sideritis. It is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Greece, characterized by its small white or purple flowers and needle-like leaves. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, thanks to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Sideritis cretica var. stricta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exert therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, and also exhibit antispasmodic and sedative properties.
